title: Split Array Largest Sum
summary: Split nums into exactly k nonempty contiguous pieces.

contractDetails.output-checking: Exact typed equality of the returned int.

statement: Split nums into exactly k nonempty contiguous pieces. Minimize the largest piece sum and return that minimum possible value.

examples.explanation: The two piece sums can be 4 and 6.
Nonempty pieces may have zero sum.
Every entry must be its own piece.

hints: Conceptual: A maximum allowed sum determines whether a partition is possible.
Directional: Search the bound and count pieces with a greedy scan.
Implementation: Use the largest entry as the lower bound and the total sum as the upper bound. Nonnegative values let a partition using fewer than k pieces be split further.
complexityAnalysis: O(n log(S+1)) time and O(1) auxiliary space, where S is the total sum.
